title: Practice regex primitives
description: This harness checks patterns written from regular-expression primitives and character classes.

steps.description: Each task provides a description, an unfinished pattern slot, strings that should match, and strings that should not match.
The loop prints the task description. A None pattern reports that the task is unfinished and skips its tests.

steps.question: What happens for every task before you replace the None patterns?
steps.answer: Each task prints '(not written yet)' and the loop moves to the next task.

steps.description: Once a pattern is present, fullmatch tests every positive and negative example. Each line reports whether the result agrees with the expected outcome.
The first task reaches the unfinished-pattern branch.
